meta.task: Design a battery for power tools: nominal capacity >= 2 Ah, support 5C discharge (capacity retention >= 95%), support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), maximum temperature <= 60C, power density >= 4000 W/kg.

objective_breakdown: Capacity >=2 Ah; 5C retention >=95%; 4C charge no plating; T_max <=333.15 K; power density >=4000 W/kg.
candidate_strategy: Stage-3 Chen2020 baseline, then architecture and transport variants; evaluate 1C, 5C DFN, 4C/45C coupled thermal/plating and calc-energy.
budget_allocation: Baseline plus compact rounds of 2-4 variants; stop blind tuning after three same-cause strikes; true compute disabled.
risk_and_fallback: Capacity/power failures route to architecture; plating/temperature route to transport, particles, separator/current collectors, or cooling; material escalation if ceiling indicates it.

llm_reason: Deterministic Chen2020 baseline because electrode system unspecified; characterize ceiling and limiting metrics.

candidates.name: V1_high_transport
candidates.role: Higher electrolyte conductivity/diffusivity, smaller particles, thinner inactive layers, improved cooling

llm_reason: Architecture and transport fallback targets rate polarization, plating, thermal rise, and inactive mass.

candidates.name: V2_high_rate
candidates.role: Aggressive high-transport, 2 um particles, thin separator/current collectors, stronger cooling

llm_reason: Second fallback increases rate margin after V1 still failed 5C retention and temperature.

note: Baseline fails 5C retention and 4C temperature; plating remains positive.｜未检查 criteria: rate_retention_5C, power_density_w_kg

Derived 5C retention passes 95 percent.｜未检查 criteria: capacity_ah, power_density_w_kg, T_max_K, plated

recommendation: V2_high_rate Chen2020 design: 5.066 Ah nominal 1C capacity, 98.35% 5C retention, 3.18e6 W/kg contract power density, 328.63 K (55.48 C) maximum temperature during coupled 4C/45C charge, and no plating (minimum anode potential 0.02563 V). Values are tool outputs or mechanically derived files; electrolyte mass is excluded by calc-energy contract.
